## Context / Problem
Cites are on origin/main 083620b0.

`src/rebar/_engine_support/resolver.py` is a whole-file re-export of `rebar._ids` (its docstring `:8` says "every existing importer is unchanged"). `src/rebar/reducer/_processors.py:18-31` re-exports 7 names from `_processors_identity`/`_processors_status` marked `# noqa: F401 (re-exported for back-compat)`. ADR 0111 (`docs/adr/0111-no-internal-only-compatibility-shims.md:40-57`) forbids internal-only shims and requires atomic migration of "source, test, string, dynamic import, and monkeypatch" targets. This story touches 54 files on import lines only; landing it first means every other epic rebases over one-line import diffs.

## Approach
One commit: rewrite every importer to the canonical module, delete the two shims, fix monkeypatch strings. Serena `find_referencing_symbols` on `resolve_ticket_id` + `git grep` for the module string (both required by AGENTS.md).

`from rebar._engine_support.resolver import X` → `from rebar._ids import X` at: `scripts/backtest_bugfix_size.py:70`; `src/rebar/_commands/{_seam.py:29, close_precheck.py:28,115, compact.py:48, composer.py:26, composer_edit.py:31, delete.py:32, link_revert.py:26, transition.py:27, transition_close.py:227,296, unlink.py:24, verify_commit.py:25}`; `src/rebar/_engine_support/{commit_impact.py:235, descendants.py:15, field_reads.py:30, lookups.py:15, next_batch.py:27, reads.py:37}`; `src/rebar/_lib_writes.py:329,418`; `src/rebar/audit/read.py:140`; `src/rebar/llm/code_review/{assemble.py:288, bugfix_size_gate.py:185, finalize.py:98, sidecar.py:197,282,323}`; `src/rebar/llm/completion_sidecar.py:260,295,339,406`; `src/rebar/llm/gate_runs.py:170`; `src/rebar/llm/overlap/{digest_sidecar.py:84, queue.py:77}`; `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/sidecar.py:121,171,219,274`; `src/rebar/metrics/blame.py:28`; `src/rebar/review_bot/artifact_emit.py:80`; `src/rebar/signing.py:270`; tests: `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/{test_completion_gate.py:29, test_plan_review_gate.py:559,588, test_transition_pre_status_check.py:14, test_transition_reason_honest_3803.py:98}`, `tests/interfaces/store/{test_completion_verifier.py:460, test_sidecar_reader.py:86,105,125,157}`, `tests/scripts/reducer/test_ticket_alias_backfill.py:30`, `tests/unit/test_audit_retention_cap.py:42`, `tests/unit/workflow/{test_completion_token_recovery_heldout.py:127, test_gate_error_sidecar.py:94, test_gate_error_sidecar_heldout.py:67}`.

Module-object form `from rebar._engine_support import resolver as _resolver` → `from rebar import _ids as _resolver`: `tests/unit/commands/test_replacement_walker.py:46`, `tests/unit/test_close_precheck_duplicate_link_c8fd.py:59`, `tests/unit/test_attach_commits.py:397`. Attribute form `rebar._engine_support.resolver.resolve_ticket_id(...)` → `rebar._ids.resolve_ticket_id(...)`: `tests/unit/{test_compact_sweep_perf.py:75, test_compact_trigger.py:70, test_completion_sidecar_lock_loss_ab54.py:99, test_relocated_store_repo_root.py:240}`. Monkeypatch string `tests/unit/test_completion_sidecar_material_balding.py:228` → `"rebar._ids.resolve_ticket_dir_name"` (valid because every consumer imports in-body from `rebar._ids`). Prose: `docs/bash-migration.md:168`, `src/rebar/_alias.py:4,36`, `src/rebar/_ids.py:23`, `tests/scripts/reducer/test_ticket_alias_backfill.py:7,119` → say `rebar._ids`.

`_processors.py`: delete lines 21,23,24,27-30 (the seven `noqa` re-exports; keep `_bootstrap_genesis_keyring`, `_fold_author_attribution`, `attestation_kind` — used at `:81,155,213,344,609,627`). Importers: `src/rebar/reducer/_replay.py:19-38` import `process_key_event`, `process_signature` from `._processors_identity` and `process_status` from `._processors_status`; tests `tests/unit/test_attestations_reducer.py:13-18`, `test_claimed_session.py:20`, `test_harness_provenance.py:20`, `test_legacy_signature_mirror_drop.py:15`, `test_plan_review_phase_happy.py:6`, `test_plan_review_phase_reducer.py:10`, `test_signing.py:316,332` import from the defining module. `_fold_*`/`_rederive_keyring_keys` have zero external importers. Delete `src/rebar/_engine_support/resolver.py`.

## Scope
Exactly the files above: `src/rebar/_engine_support/resolver.py` (deleted), `src/rebar/reducer/_processors.py`, `src/rebar/reducer/_replay.py`, the `src/rebar/_commands/*.py`, `src/rebar/_engine_support/*.py`, `src/rebar/llm/**/*.py`, `src/rebar/{_lib_writes.py,signing.py,audit/read.py,metrics/blame.py,review_bot/artifact_emit.py,_alias.py,_ids.py}`, `scripts/backtest_bugfix_size.py`, `docs/bash-migration.md` and `tests/**` sites listed in Approach; no behaviour change; no new names. Out of scope: every file not named above, any behaviour change, any new name, and the bodies of the canonical modules `rebar._ids`, `_processors_identity` and `_processors_status`.

## Testing
- Happy: `git grep -n '_engine_support.resolver\|_engine_support import resolver' -- src tests scripts` returns nothing; `python -c "import rebar._engine_support.resolver"` raises `ModuleNotFoundError`.
- Edge: `pytest tests/unit/test_completion_sidecar_material_balding.py tests/unit/commands/test_replacement_walker.py tests/unit/test_close_precheck_duplicate_link_c8fd.py tests/unit/test_attach_commits.py -q` green (monkeypatch retargeting proves the in-body import path).
- `ruff check src tests scripts` shows no F401 in `_processors.py`; `make verify`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] AC1 `src/rebar/_engine_support/resolver.py` deleted; `git grep -n '_engine_support.resolver\|_engine_support import resolver' -- src tests scripts` empty (verified by the grep).
- [ ] AC2 `_processors.py` has no `re-exported for back-compat` lines; `git grep 'from rebar.reducer._processors import' -- src tests` shows no `process_status|process_signature|process_key_event` (verified by grep).
- [ ] AC3 `python -c "import rebar._engine_support.resolver"` raises `ModuleNotFoundError` and the four monkeypatch/module-object tests above are green (verified by `pytest`).
- [ ] AC4 `make verify` green.
